meta.title: Farm Management Software for Uzbekistan | Yuksalish Agro
meta.description: Run fields, livestock, warehouse, money and staff in one system. Works on a phone, and field records save without internet. Ask for a demo.

problem.title: but the numbers are scattered
problem.lead: Records sit in notebooks, Excel files and Telegram groups. Getting an answer means waiting for the end of the month.

items.title: Feed runs out without warning

items.title: Field records get lost

trust.label: Trust
trust.title: belongs to you alone
trust.lead: Farm data is a business secret, so security is built into the foundation of the product.

items.title: Every farm is separate
items.body: Farm data is separated at the database level. No other customer can see your numbers.

items.title: Finance stays closed
items.body: Only permitted staff see prices and costs, and the server enforces it.

items.title: Two-person approval
items.body: A large payment does not reach the books until a second person confirms it.

items.title: Every change is recorded
items.body: Who changed what, and when, is kept on record.

items.title: Two-step sign-in
items.body: Protect your account with a password and a confirmation code.

items.title: AI never writes on its own
items.body: The assistant only proposes. A record is saved after you confirm it.

items.a: Livestock, crop and mixed farms: cattle, sheep, goats, horses and more. You can run several farms from one account.
Yes. Daily logs, illness, deaths, weights and birth records stay on the phone and send themselves when the connection returns.

items.q: Do I need to install an app?
items.a: No. It opens in a browser, and you can add it to your phone's home screen like an app. It works on a computer too.
The price depends on the size of your farm and the modules you need. Send a request and we will give you an offer.

items.q: What happens to my Excel files?
items.a: You can upload fields, animals, feed stock, staff, machinery and counterparties using ready-made templates.
Each farm's data is kept separately, access is limited by role, every change is recorded, and backups are taken.
No. Herders and other staff do not see prices or costs. The server enforces this, not just the screen.
Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian and English. Each person chooses their own language.

items.q: Can the AI assistant change my data?
items.a: No. It answers questions and prepares records, but nothing is saved until you confirm it.
